verdict.rationale: Unreal ships official command-line surfaces: engine launch arguments, UnrealEditor.exe commandlets such as -run=cook, and the Unreal Automation Tool, which can cook, package, deploy and run projects. These are build, cook and launch tools rather than a unified, agent-oriented CLI, and nothing in the evidence documents them for AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: a single official CLI designed for agent/AI-native use, structured machine-readable output, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven CLI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Unreal Automation Tool is a generic system used to automate processes, including testing and building games.
This command can cook content for a platform, package it up into a platform's native format for distribution, deploys it to the device, and automatically runs the project
Command-line Arguments, also called Additional Launch Parameters, customize how the engine runs on startup.
